department_name: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department
department_name_hindi: किसान कल्याण तथा कृषि विकास विभाग
description: The apex nodal department driving agricultural growth, crop production enhancement, soil conservation, and economic welfare for farming communities across Madhya Pradesh.
sub_divisions: State Agriculture Marketing Board (MP Mandi Board)
primary_functions: Ensuring availability of certified seeds, quality fertilizers, and micro-nutrients to farmers
Implementation of central and state farm schemes like PM-KISAN, PM Fasal Bima Yojana, and Subsidies
Promotion of modern farming techniques, organic farming, micro-irrigation, and mechanization
Regulation and management of agricultural produce markets (Krishi Upaj Mandis)
Soil health testing, crop damage assessment, and agricultural advisory services
key_services_offered: Subsidized distribution of seeds, fertilizers, and agricultural machinery via MP Krishi Portal
Registration and claim processing under Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)
Soil Health Card generation and customized crop recommendation services
Online tracking of Mandi procurement prices and digital gate pass issuing
